text: RESULTS: Skin_rash_morphology: Erythematous maculopapular rash and pustules with an erythematous base observed over the trunk and extremities. Palms and soles are spared. Feeding_and_activity_status: Information not provided in available data.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The rash described as an erythematous maculopapular eruption with pustules on the trunk and extremities, sparing the palms and soles, is highly suggestive of a specific neonatal condition. Has the mother experienced fever or flu-like symptoms around the time of delivery?

REQUEST TEST: Maternal_temperature_and_symptoms
REQUEST IMAGES: Full_body_skin_examination

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Varicella (Congenital Chickenpox). The presence of an erythematous maculopapular rash with pustules that spare the palms and soles, combined with normal vital signs suggesting a non-septic etiology, is classic for varicella infection acquired in utero or shortly before birth.
